invariant: Increase reachable useful states while reducing the cost of choosing and entering them.

layers.name: FEDERATION / MEMORY
layers.law: Many objects may exist; existence creates no execution obligation.

layers.name: CAPABILITY KERNEL
layers.law: Projects compose reusable transformations rather than competing as sovereign peers.

layers.name: FORWARD CENTER MASS
layers.law: At most three active execution fronts; each must terminate in a RETURN receipt.

admission: benefits multiple domains or unlocks a high-value bottleneck
produces an observable state change in one bounded pass
failure leaves reusable information or artifact residue
cheap to abandon relative to dependency created
ships something or measurably expands future controllability
note: Operator assignment and FCM score are experimental projections, never canon.
